EIP-7702 Client Issues (Erigon) Also we had our first successful consolidation with the effective balance going up too 😄 <@741245312009633792> could you look at the erigon failures please? info in the thread mentioned a few messages above consolidations of consolidations also work as expected and I added lighthouse to the mix too 🙂

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content:
^ minimal kurtosis config to use if you're interested:
```
participants_matrix:
  el:
    - el_type: erigon
      el_image: ethpandaops/erigon:docker_pectra_temp
    - el_type: reth
      el_image: ethpandaops/reth:onbjerg-devnet-3
  cl:
    - cl_type: nimbus
      cl_image: ethpandaops/nimbus-eth2:unstable
    - cl_type: lighthouse
      cl_image: ethpandaops/lighthouse:unstable
    - cl_type: prysm
      cl_image: ethpandaops/prysm-beacon-chain:develop
      vc_image: ethpandaops/prysm-validator:develop
network_params:
  electra_fork_epoch: 1
  min_validator_withdrawability_delay: 1
  shard_committee_period: 1
  churn_limit_quotient: 16
additional_services:
  - dora
  - assertoor
```
